steps.npc: It's a desolate, sad place... The peoples here seldom feed me - take me with you!

steps.player: I'm sorry, I can't take you with me, but I will help if I can.

steps.npc: Not well, I have to ssssssay, but you look healthy. I wish I were healthy like you.
Sniff, sniff* I don't think it's me. All I can smell is dirty vyrewatches tithing the poor humans.

options.text: How long have you been here?

steps.player: How long have you been here?

steps.npc: As long as I can remember. So far we've not found any way out of this place, and after all, we couldn't leave these poor humans to fend for themselves.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: All this work they're doing to fix this place up and they still barely feed me anything! It's an outrage!

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: There's plenty of rats around. Maybe you could help out with the work by getting rid of a few.
